description: Decision 104: base-load sectors = residential + commercial + agriculture and others + transport electricity of DEMAND_2050_BY_COUNTRY_SECTOR_CARRIER.csv (UNSD 2019 x bridge x AEO8 growth); industry electricity only in the bas_fixed comparison. ASEAN 1032.4 TWh (former 1079.4); VN 197.2 TWh (former 30.0, 2019 base 95.1)

Decision 104: electricity uses modelled separately and therefore not in the base load (industry route electricity, EV / FCEV from the land-transport fuel rows, agriculture machinery from the agriculture oil rows, electric cooking from the biomass cooking rows, industrial heat options, endogenous conversions); the electricity rows of residential, commercial, agriculture and others and transport have no load of their own

Decision 104: research.demand.nonindustrial_electricity = table_sectors (main: per country the Astar base load is scaled to the 2050 demand-table electricity of the sectors not modelled separately; Astar = hourly shape and node split only) | astar_residual (former: Astar minus the ratio-method industry electricity and the transport electricity; comparison, default when absent)

Decision 104 finding: the demand-table transport electricity row (rail, existing electric road) was deducted from Astar in the former method as 'embedded' but no explicit load replaced it (the EV loads convert the non-electric fuel rows only); table_sectors keeps it in the base load. This is the only difference to the S4I A5 scheme (b) column: ID 0.77, MY 1.06, PH 0.26, SG 4.75, TH 0.55 TWh
